scope: Preserve Media Library references in legacy sanci-document page backgrounds and fail closed when legacy page selection or traversal exceeds the shared scan budget.

finding.reproduction: The public Page Model normalizer accepts legacy sanci-document documents with pages[].root.children[]. A published legacy node may resolve style.backgroundAssetId at render time, but the shared media usage and public authorization scanner previously read only canonical pages[pageId]. That made a rendered background appear unused to archive protection and denied its public media URL.
finding.fix: Adapt only the requested legacy page into the bounded scanner's Page Model. Use an iterative depth-first traversal with a shared 20,000-entry budget; reject duplicate or prototype-sensitive IDs and mark incomplete on depth, page-selection, or entry-budget exhaustion. Incomplete scans cannot authorize public delivery or retention and return no guessed references.
regressions: Legacy draft and published backgroundAssetId references are reported and the actually rendered published image is delivered.
A legacy tree deeper than the scanner cap yields incomplete usage, blocks archive, denies public media, and preserves the local R2 fixture.
A matching legacy page after 20,000 page candidates yields incomplete usage, blocks archive, denies public media, and preserves the local R2 fixture.
